remarks: There are homes you live in, and then there are homes you love, and 166 Woodside Avenue has always been the second kind. Set within the McKinley Historic District in the heart of South Buffalo, this home has been cared for with a level of devotion you can feel the moment you walk through the door. Every detail here tells the story of sellers who truly loved where they lived, and who poured their heart into making it better with every passing year.  Nowhere is that more evident than the front garden, the true pride and joy of this home. Planted and tended by hand, it bursts with butterflies and native pollinators each season, a living reminder of the care that went into every inch of this property. It's the kind of garden that stops neighbors mid walk to admire it, and it sets the tone for everything else you'll find here.  Step inside and that same thoughtfulness carries through every room. The kitchen was completely reimagined, with new electrical and plumbing behind the walls to match, and the bathroom was refreshed with the same attention to detail. Hardwood floors were refinished to a warm, inviting glow, new vinyl and glass block windows were installed throughout, and even the side entry was given fresh carpet underfoot. Out front, a rebuilt covered porch invites you to slow down and enjoy the view of that beloved garden, while the backyard was reworked with new exterior outlets and its own berry bushes, made for quiet mornings and easy evenings alike. Even the roof was replaced with long term peace of mind, because these sellers wanted whoever came next to feel just as secure as they did.  This isn't just a house that was maintained. It's a home that was loved, nurtured, and genuinely enjoyed, down to the last flower bed. Tucked into one of South Buffalo's most storied pockets, 166 Woodside Avenue stands out as a true labor of love. Now it's ready for its next chapter, and for someone new to fall for it the way these sellers did. Come experience 166 Woodside Avenue for yourself.
